card.name: Opening parenthesis after a study statistic
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a reported number or summary value in trial results, where a range, count or fraction follows. It is strongest after a mean or median such as days or months.

modes.label: Range after a mean or median
modes.description: A parenthesis after a time value, introducing a range of values.

modes.label: Count or fraction after a percent
modes.description: A parenthesis after a percentage, introducing n/N counts.

card.writes: It lowers statistics words such as statistical, regression and correlation, so a plain range or count is expected rather than analysis terms.
card.plain: It marks the bracket after a trial number where a range or patient count comes next.
